entries.note: Start a candidate MCP tool implementation with a private immutable root/host context, check required tools and the actual workspace_info binding, then close it. This is an MCP protocol probe, not a coding agent/provider conversation. The supervisor publishes a connector generation only after this check; facades then replace their tool worker between requests.

Tool implementation lives in a replaceable process behind the stable facade. Resolve only a validated runtime descriptor for the original host, retain the original root and reject foreign sessions/desktops before each operation. Probe/update/status never launches a coding conversation. The existing eight-tool connector can remain running while an agent uses runtime/client.mjs with its original context.
